_about: Error-analysis notes for the final frozen-prompt (v3) run. Documentation only; never read by the labelling pipeline.
AVT-018: No blocker extracted (treatment doubts present), so the label fell through to Vague Deferral. v1 had this right. Open issue: v3 under-extracts blockers.
AVT-020: Wife needed only to manage timing (logistics = Travel), but read as a family decision. Open issue.
AVT-028: Cost question about concessions not kept as the final blocker; fell through to Vague Deferral. Open issue: blocker under-extraction.
AVT-031: Work schedule (Travel) not extracted as a blocker; the deferral backstop then set Vague Deferral. Open issue: blocker under-extraction.
AVT-032: A routine 'send any location' request was read as an information request. Open issue.
AVT-034: Final 'I will talk at home' not extracted as Family Discussion; read as an information request. Open issue.
AVT-038: Ongoing medicine (Current Treatment) sits early in a long call; a later price question won. Open issue.
AVT-041: v3 fixed the false booking (now correctly Follow-up), but the travel/timing blocker was not extracted, so Information Requested. Open issue.
AVT-042: 'Forget it' read as an unconditional refusal; the key treats it as open (Treatment Concern). Open issue.
AVT-043: 'Consult my family at home and then decide' is a vague postponement (+3 days) that the model and the phrase backstop missed. Open issue.
AVT-047: Clinic reviewing reports (Treatment Concern) not extracted as a blocker; the 15-minute callback took over as Specific Callback. Open issue.
AVT-048: Agent's 'I'll call you back tomorrow' answered with 'Alright' was not marked acknowledged, so vague (+3) instead of tomorrow. Open issue.
AVT-049: 'Speak to my office … insurance' (Cost) outranked by 'discuss at home as well' (Family). Open issue.
